items.title: Interceptor how?
items.text:
Interceptor how?
I enjoy the fast interceptor playstyle, but coming from a Ranger, and then a Colossus, how do you guys do damage? My Interceptor is sitting at 704 power, but hits for like 4k per melee (it's set up for perma combo).The combo damage proc is laughable, and hitting for 4k is comparable to a lot of weapons who rolled decent, so where's the damage at? Both Ranger and Colossus can murder everything in the vicinity much faster, so.. is Interceptor for survivability?

I don't mean to offend anybody, I'm merely curious as to how I'm supposed to not take forever to kill stuff.

&#x200B;

Edit:Thank you all so much for your help! I definently have a lot of grinding to do for some melee inscription, and I'll put the combo build on the shelf for now! Best sub!

I'm sticking to GM2 atm. GM3 is laughable with a 704 colossus, but I have slower killtime on gm2 with interceptor. It just boggles me. But I'll heed your advice and stick with it, cause it is super fun to play. I just feel like others have to carry me because I hit like a wet noodle.

items.title: Ingame purchase not showing up? Too bad!
items.text:
Ingame purchase not showing up? Too bad!
So, I just got done with a conversation with EA support about an ingame purchase, where I didn't receive the item.  


I'm just warning everybody else. If you buy something, and an error happens where it takes your money but doesn't give you the item, YOU ARE SCREWED, and they won't do shit about it.

Just a heads up to all my fellow freelancers out there!
Which one of them is best at spreading this kind of customer abuse?
Alright, thanks for the heads up. I'll contact all of them.
Thank you! I definently will do!

I bought an item, it subtracted my currency, item stayed in the "buy" tab instead of moving to the "equip" tab. I contacted support and they confirmed that I indeed bought the item. Then they said they could not add the item to my account, nor provide a refund.

I honestly don't give a damn if people believe me. I try to warn people. What you do with that information is up to you.

They told me try several steps like restarting system, repair game and wait 24 hours from purchase. All steps have been taken.
Meh. Doesnt bother me. It bothers me when I don't get what I paid for
